correctness.rationale: The beta-moment coefficients for unnormalized planar area and radial operator D=(s d/ds)' give H_t(0)=2−4B_t/A_t^2 as stated. Its derivative has the positive factor 2t^2+18t+39 on t>−1 (it is positive at −1 and increasing thereafter). With p=t+2 and e=1−s, the kernel is e^(-p) times a smooth positive factor times [1+O(e^p)], the last factor having kth differentiated errors O(e^(p−k)) through order four. Thus g=p/e^2 times [1+O(e^min(2,p))] with differentiated bounds through order two, implying the stated curvature limit. Comparing center and boundary values gives rigidity. Independently deriving the rational t=4 kernel from binomial moment coefficients, then differentiating and isolating the roots, reproduced P/(6R^3), the exact endpoint signs at the rational bracket, and precisely one root in (0,1). The analytic sign certificate follows because the negative term −80388s^10 in P' strictly dominates 1764s^11 throughout that interval. Continuity supplies existence where only existence is claimed.
residual_risks: The symbolic replay checks t=4, not the real-parameter boundary limit; the latter is justified analytically. It gives s=0.01759750335987177921 and r=0.13265558171397002777 as numerical diagnostics, not as certificates.
